_comment: Qwen Code (the CLI, forked from Gemini CLI) — this one IS standard: merge the mcpServers block into ~/.qwen/settings.json (user scope) or .qwen/settings.json (project scope), or run: qwen mcp add plan-audit-map --transport stdio -- node <abs>/dist/index.js. The installer writes the resolved copy as qwen-code-settings.local.json.
